headline: Yutaka Giken Co., Ltd. Begins Recovery Post-Malware Shutdown
body: Following a recent malware attack, Yutaka Giken Co., Ltd. has initiated recovery efforts. The automotive components supplier experienced a widespread infection that led to the shutdown of multiple production sites. Systems have since been restored, and operations are gradually resuming. Yutaka Giken Co., Ltd. estimates a modest single-digit-percentage impact on its revenue due to the incident. The company is collaborating with cybersecurity experts to prevent future breaches.
